title: Boolean and Advanced Indexing knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes “Boolean masks” in this lesson?
options: This topic guarantees identical results across all devices and package versions.
This topic makes every serialized checkpoint safe to load from an unknown source.
Choose a dtype that fits the data range and required precision; verify conversion behavior instead of assuming values are unchanged.
This topic removes the need to validate inputs or inspect model outputs.
questions.answer_key: Choose a dtype that fits the data range and required precision; verify conversion behavior instead of assuming values are unchanged.
questions.explanation: Boolean masks: Choose a dtype that fits the data range and required precision; verify conversion behavior instead of assuming values are unchanged.

questions.prompt: Before relying on “Conditional selection”, what should a learner verify?
options: Skip recording package versions because they cannot affect API or device behavior.
print or assert shape, dtype, and expected values after every shape-changing or reduction operation.
Assume all tensor dimensions and devices are interchangeable without checking them.
Use the held-out test split repeatedly to tune the model and report that score as unbiased.
questions.answer_key: print or assert shape, dtype, and expected values after every shape-changing or reduction operation.
questions.explanation: This lesson recommends the following check: print or assert shape, dtype, and expected values after every shape-changing or reduction operation.

options: Do not reshape a tensor by guessing dimensions; preserve the element count and verify the resulting axis meanings.
Change several unrelated settings at once and infer which change fixed the result.
Treat successful imports as proof that the full model and evaluation pipeline are correct.
Catch every exception and silently replace failed results with zeros.
questions.answer_key: Do not reshape a tensor by guessing dimensions; preserve the element count and verify the resulting axis meanings.
questions.explanation: This topic-specific caution is important: Do not reshape a tensor by guessing dimensions; preserve the element count and verify the resulting axis meanings.
